name: As Seen on TV Testor's Spray Chalk 4 Color Kit
description: Testor's Spray Chalk 4 Color Kit Channel your inner child and let your imagination break free with this decorative spray chalk. Create temporary markings on outdoor surfaces such as concrete, grass, asphalt, snow, sand, pavers, vinyl, siding and glass. It's instant fun, but with sidewalk chalk effects. It fades to white in 7 days and washes off naturally with the rain, allowing customization over and over again. How about a colorful rainbow? What You Get Spray chalk kit (4 12 oz. cans) Plastic spray grip Good to Know Shake well before and during use. Hold the can 4" to 10" from surface. If spraying toward the ground, hold can at a 45 degree angle. Wipe the spray tip after use to avoid buildup. If the tip clogs, run under warm water to clean. Wash away Spray Chalk with water pressure from a garden hose. Light brushing may be necessary on porous surfaces. Long-term contact or extended exposure to sunlight may result in left over residue on surface. If on clothing, wash clothing promptly with an oxygen-based cleaning product. Shelf life 3 years

name: Derwent Inktense Colored Pencil Set with Tin, Assorted Colors, Set of
description: Water-soluble color helps in creating a translucent ink-like effect by applying a wash on pure, vibrant dry lines. Once colors are washed out, they dry quickly with very little bleed occurring, so colors can be positioned next to each other without bleeding into each other. Colors are permanent once dry and other medias can be used over them. Pencil offers enhanced effect when applied to a dark backgrounds.

name: Sennelier Venetian Turpentine
description: Add to oil paints, mediums and varnishes Resin is extracted from European larch trees in its pure, undiluted, honey-like state. Balsam lends an exquisite jewel-like quality with a tough, enamel-like surface. Use the turpentine sparingly, making up no more than 5% of the total paint mixture. Dilute with turpentine up to 20%. Sennelier Art & Drafting Supplies part of a large selection of office supplies. Made by Sennelier.
